summary: Resolve Goal targets in umbrella workspaces

delivery.outcome: `koru goal` resolves one Git repository before invoking Goal or an agent, fails closed for ambiguous umbrella workspaces, and supports explicit path-confined `--repo` selection. Publish this Koru change through a PR and protected exact-head validator approval and merge.
nonGoals: Do not recursively choose among nested repositories or infer operator intent when zero or multiple immediate children are dirty
Do not change Goal behavior or governance policy
Do not modify, remediate, push or publish any Autogrammar child repository during validation

architecture.decision: Resolve the target synchronously before constructing the agent remediator: accept a direct Git root, accept an explicit relative in-workspace Git root, or select the sole dirty immediate child; otherwise return a structured fail-closed selection error.
interfaceChanges: Add `koru goal --repo RELATIVE_PATH` and fail-closed umbrella target selection
architecture.rollback: Remove the workspace resolver and `--repo`; direct `--project` behavior remains available.

validation.evidence: Focused direct, unique, ambiguous, escape and no-launch tests

commands: python -m ruff check src/koru/goal_workspace.py src/koru/cli_goal.py tests/test_goal_workspace.py
